summary.value: A bare-bones TypeScript project that adds CKEditor's collaboration features one at a time - comments, track changes, revision history, real-time collaboration - each in its minimal possible setup.

content.value:
What's inside

The premium collaboration features, decomposed: comments, track changes, revision history, and real-time collaboration, each introduced iteratively in the smallest setup that works. No framework, no styling detours - just the sequence of steps and the configuration each feature actually requires.

Why it exists

Collaboration features look monolithic from the outside; this repo shows they compose. It accompanies my article on decomposing collaboration features, where each step is explained in order.
